title: REQ · Asset folder structure holds real temporary pixel-art files
summary: Folders for world and ui assets exist, each containing a real file.
description: Context: no game/public/assets exists. Desired behavior: create worlds/the-boys-room/{backgrounds,furniture,objects,characters,effects,audio} and ui/{icons,frames,cursors}, each with at least one real temporary asset (SVG, plus a short WAV for audio). Expected result: no empty folders or gray placeholders. Why: gives the manifest real files to reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/public/assets, when listed, then worlds/the-boys-room has the 6 required subfolders and ui has icons, frames and cursors
Given each folder, when read, then it contains at least one non-empty file
Given each SVG, when read, then it starts with an svg root element
technical_constraints: Original temporary assets only, no stock images
definition_of_done: Folders and files exist and are committed
